Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: Proteins were shown to move about in a plane of the plasma membrane when mouse cellsurface proteins and human cell-surface proteins were observed to integrate along a fused mouse-human cell plasma membrane. Which of the following cell culture techniques was most likely employed in order to yield these results?

Options: 
A. Inserting a bacterial plasmid into a mammalian cell
B. Producing a hybrid cell
C. Injecting a fluorescent marker into the cell membrane
D. Producing a heterokaryon
E. Isolating an immortal variant cell from culture and using it to create a cell line
F. Inserting a tumor-inducing virus into a normal cell to initiate transformation
G. Using a method called cell fusion to combine the mouse and human cells
H. Using a technique called transfection to insert new genes
I. Using a process called somatic cell nuclear transfer
J. Inducing pluripotency in somatic cells to create stem cells

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.

While "producing a hybrid cell" (Option B) is the result of this procedure, "using a method called cell fusion" (Option G) accurately names the specific cell culture technique utilized to achieve the observation.
